Check the bundled snapshot against the live Police.uk source

Source: R/source.R
btg_source_status.Rd

Reads the Police.uk availability feed, which lists for each published month the forces whose stop and search data are present, and compares it with the bundled release: whether newer months have been published since the snapshot's source month, and whether any force-month inside the snapshot's verified coverage window has since been added (a late submission) or withdrawn. This is the package's only use of the network; it changes nothing and, when the feed cannot be read, returns NULL with a message rather than an error.

Usage

btg_source_status(release = NULL, timeout = 10, url = .availability_url)

Arguments

release

A value from btg_releases(); NULL uses the default catalogue release.

timeout

Seconds to wait for the feed.

url

The feed address, which the manifest also records.

Value

NULL when the feed could not be read; otherwise a list of class btg_source_status with checked_at, snapshot_month, latest_month, newer_months (one row per month published after the snapshot with the number of forces listed), months (one row per shared month: forces listed live, forces supplied in the snapshot, late additions and withdrawals) and changes (one row per force-month whose availability differs, with the bundled status). Printing it summarises these.

Details

The feed describes availability, not counts: a force listed for a month has published some stop and search records for it. A late addition means the source now holds a return the snapshot recorded as missing; a withdrawal means the snapshot recorded a supplied return that the feed no longer lists. Either is a reason to build a new release rather than to edit this one. The feed covers a rolling window of recent months, so months the snapshot verified before that window cannot be compared and are not counted.

Examples

# \donttest{
status <- btg_source_status(timeout = 5)
if (!is.null(status)) status
#> Police.uk source checked 2026-10-23T13:27:40Z
#> Bundled release dashboard-2026-07-catalogue-bacf49c2a48d holds source month 2026-07; the feed lists months to 2026-08.
#> 1 newer month(s): 2026-08 (28 forces).
#> Across 35 month(s) both describe (2023-09 to 2026-07): 3 late addition(s) and 0 withdrawal(s); see $changes.
# }
